## Player-visible condition

Describe what is wrong, desired, surprising, or newly possible without prescribing the implementation.

## Current story

What happens today?

## Desired outcome

What observable result matters?

## Known constraints

What must remain true?

## Hidden/discoverable conditions

| Condition | How player can discover it | Consequence if missed |
|---|---|---|

## Plausible solution families

List at least two where appropriate. These are design notes, not instructions shown to the player.

## Failure/consequence design

How does incomplete understanding manifest fairly?

## Completion dimensions

- outcome;
- cost;
- reliability;
- human impact;
- resilience;
- understanding;
- maintainability.

## Validation

- headless assertions;
- playtest questions;
- replay expectations.
